messages:
anya: Heads-up: I'd like to bring up rwd-v3q-lite-int4 against prod long-context summarization. Goal: ~2x cost reduction w/ <1pp absolute QA regress. Need to agree AB/canary gates and auto-fallback before cutting traffic.

rory: Sounds reasonable. What's the initial validation looked like?

anya: Quick summary of bench + evals (anchor = rwd-v2p0 fp16):
- anchor QA acc (longctx): 88.4% -> candidate 87.6% (-0.8pp abs)
- anchor ROUGE-L: 51.3 -> 50.9 (-0.4)
- anchor NER F1 (entity-slice): 93.2 -> 92.0 (-1.2pp)
- anchor hallucination (cust-docs): 0.7% -> 1.1% (+0.4pp)
- P95 latency: 310ms -> 245ms (win)
- p50 token throughput per GPU: 1400 -> 2100 (win)
- cost estimate: ~45% lower per-token on int4 runtime
Notes: small NER and hallucination uptick.

jamie: NER drop is right at our soft limit. We should lock a conservative threshold for promotion. Also prefer AB (live split) rather than immediate percent ramps for longctx to catch distributional surprises.

anya: Proposal: 3-stage plan
1) Shadow for 12h on 100% sampled prod queries (no user traffic). Run offline slice eval every 3h.
2) AB 0.5% candidate vs 0.5% anchor for 8h (min 2k requests per arm).
3) If clean, ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20% (8h windows).
Auto-fallback rules baked in (immediate rollback for latency/cost anomalies, two-window confirmation for quality signals).

fiona: Can you call out concrete metric thresholds to implement in the rollout policy? Ops prefers numeric triggers.

anya: Sure. Proposed concrete triggers:
- abort_if: hallucination_delta_pp >= 0.6 (absolute) in any 2h window -> immediate rollback + page
- abort_if: qa_drop_abs_pp >= 1.0 over baseline in two consecutive windows -> rollback
- abort_if: ner_f1_drop_pp >= 1.5 (absolute) in any window -> rollback
- abort_if: p95_latency_increase_ms >= 50 -> immediate rollback (in case of infra regressions)
- require_min_sample: 1500 requests per arm per window for QA/NER comparisons
- continuous_monitoring: adversarial-slice checks every 30m

rory: For AB stats, use bootstrap CI on MRR/QA and require p<0.05 and effect size > threshold before promoting beyond 5%. Otherwise hold.

ops-bot: infra-checker: GPU pool capacity OK, no infra incidents in last 24h.

jamie: Micro-eval (2k queries) numbers I ran this morning:
```
anchor QA: 88.4
candidate QA: 87.7 (-0.7pp)
anchor NER F1: 93.2
candidate NER F1: 92.1 (-1.1pp)
halluc est: 0.7% -> 1.05% (+0.35pp)
```
Not ideal but within proposed gates if we tighten the hallucination rule to 0.5pp.

anya: I agree tighten hallucination_abort -> 0.5pp. Update: hallucination_abort 0.5pp (absolute), ner_abort 1.4pp. Keep qa_abort 1.0pp.

lucas: I'll add the two-window debounce for QA/NER and single-window immediate for latency/hallucination. Also wiring sample-size guard.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled shadow job: id=sh-20260312-11 model=rwd-v3q-lite-int4 duration=12h -> started

fiona: Action items:
- lucas: implement policy + ensure alert goes to #eng-ml and paging if immediate abort fires.
- jamie: run the adversarial slice generator for 6h and post results.
- anya: if shadow looks clean at +12h, proceed with AB 0.5%/0.5% for 8h.

rory: One more ask: add a cost-sanity check metric. If per-token cost reduction <30% (measured on live runtime) then don't promote; cost wins must be material.

anya: Good call. Add cost_delta_pct >= 30% required to consider promotion beyond 5%.

lucas: Wired the policy and test alerts. I'll post a dry-run of the detector in 30m.

jamie: starting adversarial run now. Will surface any hallucination spikes to thread.

anya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene at +4h for an early peek. :eyes:
